title: ci(fleet-write): the advisory mint comment names its four write rows and the read mint
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xU1C787MQBQdgHEzN2hGGe1)_

Fixes #29448

## What changes

Item 3 of the card, alone, because it sits on a Tier H file. Items 1 and 2 are in the companion Tier S PR, which carries `Part of #29448`.

`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`, the comment above `permission-repository-advisories` in the mint step: it said THREE consumers (`advisory_report`, `advisory_collaborators_add`, `advisory_state`). It now names the four rows that write (adding `advisory_create`), and says that `advisory_read` gets a separate READ-ONLY mint through the same input: the validator writes `permission_repository_advisories=read` for its stroke, never `write`.

Comment lines only. No step, input, `with:` value, permission or code path changes; `git diff -w` shows no changed line that is not a `#` comment, and the file still parses as YAML.

## Why

The comment documented the mint as main had it before `advisory_create` and `advisory_read` landed; the op table (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, "The four rows that touch a security advisory" and "The one row that READS an advisory") and the validator's self-test (the read's stroke mints `repository-advisories: read`, a writing row's mints `write`) are what the workflow does today.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 37 commands for this diff; all 37 exit 0 on this head, including `check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:step-collectors` and `check-comment-mask-corpus`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` itself was not run locally, the diff touches no linted package source)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (the card is split in two PRs by the seat's order, both off `main`, neither stacked)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
